abort.already_configured: Alert pills is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Alert pills is already set up.

user.description: Adds the alert pills. The pills themselves arrive from dashboards/mobile-alerts/sync.py.

data.card_only: Card only, no icon in the row

data_description.disabled: Never evaluated, never in the row or the count, even when its condition is true.
data_description.disabled_groups: Switches off every pill in the group.
data_description.card_only: Still counted and on the Alerts page, but never takes a place in the row.
data_description.places: With more pills on than places, the last one shows +N.

load.name: Load pills
load.description: Replaces the pill definitions. Called by dashboards/mobile-alerts/sync.py.

pills.name: Pills
pills.description: One entry per pill, in priority order: key, name, group, icon, color, state, and optionally content and critical.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: The groups, in the order the Alerts page shows them.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Hides a pill that is on until it turns off and on again.

toggle_dismiss.name: Dismiss or bring back
toggle_dismiss.description: Dismisses a pill, or brings it back if it is dismissed.
